name: NGC 3054, SN 2022crv field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3054, a barred spiral galaxy that hosted SN 2022crv, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2022crv-hubble
story: This galaxy hosted SN 2022crv, a stripped-envelope supernova discovered within 12 hours of explosion. Hydrogen in its light disappeared rapidly, placing it on a continuum between two families of exploding stars, Type Ib and Type IIb.

claims.text: SN 2022crv is a stripped-envelope supernova in NGC 3054
SN 2022crv was discovered within 12 hours of explosion
NGC 3054 is a barred spiral galaxy
Hydrogen disappeared rapidly; SN 2022crv shows a continuum between Type Ib and IIb properties
The Hubble target SN2022CRV is at the position of SN 2022crv
